data.summary: Bobo and 99 retain their identities and release one glowing insect without reference-sheet or interface leakage. Both follow the light, but it ends beside the rabbit ears rather than clearly above both complete heads.

observations.text: Bobo is left in green with a yellow pocket; 99 is right with pink ears, yellow pinafore, pink pocket and white sleeves. Heads and ears are complete. Bobo gradually separates his cupped paws around the single winged glow.
One distinct insect lifts away, leaving visibly empty paws below it. It rises in front of the bear muzzle and cheek toward the space between the friends, who turn their heads to follow.

Both tilt upward with smiles. The insect reaches a point above the bear crown but beside and below the rabbit ear tips. The above-both-heads requirement remains uncertain. No extra insects, incidental characters, interface badges or captions appear.
